rules: Every episode binds the exact parent runtime FMO root.
If the ROM is acquired later, its exact bytes/hash/provenance/license receipt create a successor runtime-source dataset; do not mutate the existing freeze.
Unknown or unverified runtime information is copied forward until resolved by new evidence.
JEV outputs are benchmark evidence only and are not Vithia training targets.
FCG edges are declared relationships and do not establish causality.
Corrections create successor episode datasets and preserve predecessors.
